name: live_adjustments
description: Engine Config for BMW MGU ID7. Exhaust Flap: OEM, OPEN and CLOSE over the car's own diagnostic link, or following the driving mode (Sport open, Eco Pro closed); held against the DME's timeout, Close handed back above a set engine speed. With BM3 or MHD picked in Settings: engine map switching, burbles, ASD and Max Cooling. Experimental: xDrive off until the ignition cycle (DSC LMV_FUNKTION), behind its own setting
author: custom
